title: Bulk CSV import for enterprise
synthesis_oneliner: Blocking 3 deals worth $480k ARR. Sales escalated this week.
rationale_narrative: This unblocks 3 deals worth $480k ARR. Sales escalated it this week — second time this quarter. The pattern is clear: enterprise buyers expect bulk import on day one.

evidence.label: ARR exposure
evidence.quote: Acme — 'Without bulk import we can't migrate from our current vendor.'

ai_recommendation.action_reason: Direct line to Enterprise Readiness OKR. Unblocks $480k ARR in active deals. No conflicts; eng capacity available for Sprint 2.
tradeoffs: Sequencing in Sprint 2 alongside SAML SSO uses 5 of 6 available eng-sprint slots.
Permission Groups stays in Sprint 4 — no items pushed.
Webhook Retries deferral (separate AI call) frees Sprint 3 buffer.
ai_recommendation.framework_rationale: Revenue-anchored deal blocker — RICE balances reach (3 active deals), impact ($480k unblocked), confidence (sales-validated 2x), and effort (3 sprints).
ai_recommendation.predicted_outcome: If sequenced Q3 Sprint 2: ~$480k ARR closes by end of Q3, onboarding-objection rate drops ~60% on enterprise demos.

cluster_sources.quote: Without bulk import we can't migrate from our current vendor — they're waiting on us.
Asked again about CSV upload — third call running. Said it's a non-starter for procurement.
Customer needs to migrate 8,000 records — copy-paste is not feasible. Can engineering build an API endpoint?
We have data migration on every RFP — what's your import story?

title: SSO via SAML
synthesis_oneliner: Required for 2 enterprise renewals — $340k ARR at risk.
rationale_narrative: Two enterprise renewals in Q4 are conditional on SAML SSO. This is table-stakes for enterprise; without it, we churn $340k ARR. The implementation is well-scoped.

ai_recommendation.action_reason: Direct line to Enterprise Readiness OKR. $340k Q4 renewals are time-bound. Implementation is clean (2 sprints, high eng confidence). No conflicts.
tradeoffs: Pairs naturally with Bulk CSV in Sprint 2 — same eng team, same enterprise theme.
Frees Sprint 3 entirely if Bulk CSV finishes on time — buffer for SOC2 prep.
ai_recommendation.framework_rationale: Renewal-anchored, well-scoped — RICE math is clean: reach (2 accounts), impact ($340k retained), confidence (high; CS validated), effort (2 sprints).
ai_recommendation.predicted_outcome: If shipped by end of Q3: 2 enterprise renewals retained ($340k ARR), enterprise sales cycle shortens ~1-2 weeks.

cluster_sources.quote: SAML/SSO is a hard requirement for Q3 renewal — IT security flagged it as blocker.
Their security review came back — need SAML before they sign the bigger contract.
Two accounts at risk. Both cite SSO. Single root cause across both.

title: Audit log export for SOC2
synthesis_oneliner: October audit window — $1.2M pipeline gated on compliance.
rationale_narrative: Required for SOC2 Type II compliance. Audit window is October — we need export-ready audit logs by end of Q3 to be safe. No customer pull yet, but compliance is non-negotiable for enterprise expansion.

ai_recommendation.action_reason: Hard October deadline meets eng-capacity uncertainty. $1.2M pipeline is gated. Need exec input on whether to compress timeline (parallelize) or hire compliance contractor. Above PM pay grade.
conflicts: Tight handoff: Bulk CSV wraps in Sprint 2; if it slips, eng capacity for SOC2 in Sprint 3 thins
tradeoffs: Sprint 3 sequencing leaves 4 weeks buffer before October audit — minimum safe margin.
Compressing to Sprint 2 requires either delaying Webhook fix OR hiring compliance contractor (~$30k).
Missing the window means $1.2M pipeline stalls until next audit cycle (~6 months).
ai_recommendation.okr_contribution: Sole driver of Compliance OKR. Indirect $1.2M unlock for Enterprise OKR.
ai_recommendation.framework_rationale: Compliance is non-negotiable; RICE math doesn't help when the answer is 'we need this to exist as a company.' Treating as a strategic bet — the question is timing + resourcing, not whether.
ai_recommendation.predicted_outcome: If shipped before Oct audit: $1.2M enterprise pipeline unblocks Q4. Miss the window: pipeline stalls ~6 months until next audit cycle.

suggested_escalation.draft_message: Quick call: SOC2 audit-log work needs sequencing decision. Hard October window, $1.2M pipeline gated. Two paths: (1) Sprint 3 with current eng team, ~4-week buffer to audit, OR (2) compress to Sprint 2 by deferring webhook retries OR hiring a compliance contractor (~$30k). Preference?

title: Webhook delivery retries
synthesis_oneliner: Top reliability complaint — 18 tickets, 3 customer escalations.
rationale_narrative: Webhook delivery is the #1 reliability complaint this quarter. Customers report missed events with no retry. Eng has a clean fix scoped at 1 sprint with dead-letter queue.

ai_recommendation.action_reason: Real pain but capped impact. $92k ARR mentioned vs $2M+ in Q3 priorities (Enterprise + SOC2). Recommend Q4 — keeps Reliability OKR alive without crowding out higher-ROI work.
tradeoffs: Deferring Q3 → Q4 frees 1 sprint-effort in Sprint 2, providing buffer for Bulk CSV slippage.
CS team will push back — they've been promising customers a Q3 fix.
If support volume keeps climbing, we may need to revisit mid-Q3.
ai_recommendation.okr_contribution: Reliability OKR partial credit — but the ticket-volume KR depends on this.
ai_recommendation.framework_rationale: Small effort (1 sprint, high eng confidence) but moderate value ($92k ARR exposure). Value/Effort 2×2 lands it in 'do later' relative to Q3's $2M+ enterprise priorities.
ai_recommendation.predicted_outcome: If deferred to Q4: 18 open tickets accumulate ~+30% in Q3 (CS friction). $92k ARR remains exposed. If volume spikes mid-Q3, AI will resurface for review.

title: Slack integration v2 — threaded notifications
synthesis_oneliner: High-volume request from CS — but low ARR exposure.
rationale_narrative: CS has been pushing for threaded Slack notifications for two quarters. The volume of requests is high (24 in Productboard) but the ARR impact is unclear — most asks are from customers under $20k MRR.

ai_recommendation.action_reason: High volume but low-ARR audience. Better fit for Q4 Activation push.
conflicts: Lower ROI than enterprise items in same window
tradeoffs: Q4 pairs well with Custom Fields rollout for SMB activation push.
ai_recommendation.framework_rationale: High volume of requests (24) but low MRR exposure — Value/Effort places this in the 'fast-follow / Q4 batch' quadrant, not Q3 priority.
ai_recommendation.predicted_outcome: If deferred to Q4: pairs with Custom Fields for SMB activation push. ~150 daily-active accounts lifted.

title: Permission groups (vs individual ACLs)
synthesis_oneliner: Mid-size customer pain — 8 tickets from $50k+ MRR accounts.
rationale_narrative: Mid-market customers (>$50k MRR) repeatedly hit the limit of individual ACLs. They need group permissions. Solid signal across 8 tickets and 3 customer interviews.

ai_recommendation.action_reason: Mid-market scaling — confirmed pull from $50k+ accounts. Already sequenced.
tradeoffs: Sprint 4 is light — no displacement risk.
ai_recommendation.okr_contribution: Indirect — supports mid-market expansion adjacent to Enterprise OKR.
ai_recommendation.framework_rationale: Mid-market signal with clear ARR exposure ($240k) and confirmed pull (3 interviews) — RICE math fits.
ai_recommendation.predicted_outcome: If shipped Sprint 4: 8 mid-market support tickets close, ACL-admin burden drops ~40% on $50k+ accounts.

title: Mobile push notifications
synthesis_oneliner: Low signal — 4 requests, no revenue tie. Defer.
rationale_narrative: Mobile push has been requested 4 times but with no revenue tie and no support volume. Recommend monitoring; not worth Q3 capacity.

ai_recommendation.action_reason: No revenue tie, low volume. Backlog.
ai_recommendation.framework_rationale: Low-signal monitoring item — ICE keeps it lightweight (no need for full RICE math).
ai_recommendation.predicted_outcome: Low confidence in any near-term impact. AI will resurface only if request volume crosses 10+.

title: Custom field types in workflows
rationale_narrative: Custom field types (date, dropdown, multi-select) are a growing request across mid-market and enterprise. Themes are consolidating; worth scoping for Q4.

ai_recommendation.action_reason: Growing signal, fits Q4 Activation. Pre-scoping for Q4 Sprint 1.
tradeoffs: Pairs with Slack v2 for Q4 Activation push.
ai_recommendation.framework_rationale: Growing pull but moderate effort (3 sprints) — Value/Effort places this in 'plan for next cycle.'
ai_recommendation.predicted_outcome: If shipped Q4 Sprint 1: closes a competitive feature gap; affects ~200 mid-market accounts.
